title: Deep learning combined with reinforcement learning is in its infancy
description: Systems that combine deep learning with reinforcement learning to sequentially sample the visual field in a task-specific way are still in their infancy but already outperform passive vision systems.
canonical_description: combined deep learning and reinforcement learning systems are underdeveloped

evidence.anchor: Systems combining deep learning and reinforcement learning are in their infancy
evidence.quote: Systems combining deep learning and reinforcement learning are in their infancy, but they already outperform passive vision systems <sup>99</sup> at classification tasks and produce impressive results in learning to play many different video games <sup>100</sup>.
